items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Les Brown had the band... And I worke-d at the -- I forget the name of this ballroom -- the Arcade Ballroom in New York, opposite Les Brown. He was the other band.

ctx.x: The arcade, it was at 53rd and Broadway, yeah. And why I mention this is because Les Brown had the band, and then in this band we had Eli Robinson, a very fine trombone player --
Talking about This wasn't Roy's Band?
